newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse to have no trading next week.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse to have no trading next week.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said on Thursday it would hold no session next week as it gets ready to install new software to improve trading and settlement.
The new version provides additional facilities to securities companies operating on the bourse, as well as to listed companies, a bourse statement said.
It said the bourse would be closed next Tuesday and Thursday and planned to resume trading on October 1.

Brokers said the new software was user-friendly and it would offer improved facilities including the possibility of grouping more selling and buying orders into one, shares lending and borrowing and use of custodian services.
The statement also said another seven companies, including a precision tools manufacturer, a sugar products maker and a wine producer, had applied for listing.
Bourse officials could not say when the seven stocks would obtain a quotation.
Sixteen companies are now listed on the Bursa de Valori Bucuresti but only 13 are involved in actual trading.
